info.title: DW Alliance affiliate program
info.description: Run a website's affiliate program for the signed-in person. The website (brand) is the host you call; a connection made on another website is refused. Affiliates (affiliate:join) join, manage channels and see their own referrals and commissions; referral codes and links are only ever sent to the affiliate's email. Staff (affiliate:manage) see the program, change commission rates for NEW referrals (0-100%) and file transfer requests; approving a transfer needs affiliate:transfer. Prices, the client discount and add-on plans cannot be changed through this API.

post.description: The signed-in person's affiliate account on this website: joined or not, status, channels, referral counts, the commission percent for new referrals, and the program terms. The referral code and link are never returned; use emailMyReferralLink.

post.description: Read-only report of the person's own affiliate data: referrals, conversions, commissions, ownership. Amounts are decimal strings in USD, times ISO-8601 UTC. No codes. Page with next_cursor; sync with updated_after.

period.description: For group_by period (default month; weeks start Monday; day needs from+to within 366 days).

updated_after.description: Incremental sync: only rows changed after this ISO-8601 UTC time (lists are ordered by updated_at, then id).

group_by.description: summary: period (default), code (per referral code: main link or channel, shown by id), channel (type), affiliate (staff only), none.
